Description: Current debugging of cross-service issues requires correlating logs across 23 services manually. Implement OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing. Requirements: 1) Automatic span creation for HTTP requests, gRPC calls, database queries, Kafka produce/consume 2) Context propagation via W3C Trace Context headers 3) Sampling strategy: 100% for errors, 10% for successful requests, force-sample via header for debugging 4) Trace storage in Tempo with 14-day retention 5) Grafana integration for trace visualization 6) Trace-to-log correlation via trace ID in structured logs 7) Service dependency map generated from trace data

Creator: accessibility-team

Critical issues: 1) Form inputs missing associated labels (7 instances) 2) Error messages not announced to screen readers 3) Focus order skips payment method selection 4) Color contrast insufficient on disabled button states 5) Modal dialogs trap focus incorrectly on mobile 6) Progress indicator not accessible to assistive technology 7) Timeout warning not perceivable by screen reader users. Each violation needs fix + automated test to prevent regression.

Summary: Implement API versioning strategy for breaking changes
Creator: tech-lead
Description: We need a formal API versioning strategy as we prepare for v3. Current approach (URL path versioning) is causing route explosion. Evaluate and recommend: 1) URL path versioning (current: /api/v2/) 2) Header versioning (Accept: application/vnd.api.v3+json) 3) Query parameter (?version=3) 4) Content negotiation. Consider: backwards compatibility period, sunset headers, client migration effort, documentation impact, SDK generation complexity. Produce ADR (Architecture Decision Record) with recommendation and migration plan from v2 to v3.

Summary: Set up automated database backup verification
Creator: infra-lead
Description: Backups exist but have never been verified via restore test. Implement automated verification: 1) Daily: Restore latest backup to isolated environment 2) Run integrity checks (pg_restore --verbose, row count comparison, checksum verification) 3) Execute smoke test queries against restored data 4) Report results to Slack #infra-alerts 5) Alert on any failure 6) Monthly: Full disaster recovery drill with documented RTO measurement 7) Retain restore logs for compliance audit. This is a SOC2 requirement flagged in our last audit as a gap.
Comment: 14/Jan/26 2:00 PM;bwilson;Automated restore pipeline running daily. First 5 days all successful. Average restore time: 12 minutes for 450GB database. Smoke tests verify data integrity. Slack notifications working. Documented RTO of 15 minutes.;;;

Summary: Customer merge tool: Duplicate detection algorithm improvements
Creator: product-owner
Description: Current duplicate detection uses exact email match only, missing 40% of actual duplicates. Improve algorithm: 1) Fuzzy name matching (Jaro-Winkler with 0.85 threshold) 2) Phone number normalization before comparison 3) Address standardization via USPS API 4) Email domain grouping (same person, multiple emails) 5) ML-based confidence scoring using historical merge decisions as training data 6) Human-in-the-loop for medium-confidence matches 7) Batch processing for bulk import dedup 8) Real-time check on customer creation. Performance requirement: Batch processing must handle 1M comparisons in under 10 minutes.

Summary: Migrate from Redis 6 to Redis 7 cluster mode
Creator: infra-lead
Description: Redis 6 EOL is March 2026. Migrate to Redis 7 cluster mode for improved performance and native JSON support. Migration plan: 1) Deploy Redis 7 cluster alongside Redis 6 2) Update client libraries (Jedis 5.x for Java services, ioredis 5.x for Node) 3) Enable dual-write to both clusters 4) Verify data consistency via comparison tool 5) Switch reads to Redis 7 6) Monitor for 1 week 7) Decommission Redis 6. Risk: Redis 7 changed MULTI/EXEC behavior in cluster mode - need to verify our distributed lock implementation still works.
Comment: 20/Jan/26 9:30 AM;bwilson;Redis 7 cluster deployed in staging. Client library upgrades merged for 18 of 23 services. Discovered issue with our distributed lock: the WATCH command behaves differently in cluster mode when keys hash to different slots. Implementing Redlock algorithm as replacement.;;;

Summary: Add end-to-end encryption for customer file uploads
Creator: security-team
Description: Security review finding: Customer-uploaded files (contracts, invoices, ID documents) are encrypted at rest via S3 SSE but not end-to-end encrypted. Requirement: Files must be encrypted client-side before upload using customer-specific keys. Implementation: 1) Generate per-customer AES-256 key wrapped with customer's RSA public key 2) Client-side encryption in browser using Web Crypto API 3) Upload encrypted blob to S3 4) Decryption only possible with customer's private key 5) Key rotation support without re-encrypting all files 6) Admin access via key escrow for legal/compliance requests 7) File integrity verification via HMAC

Summary: Sprint velocity report showing incorrect story points
Creator: scrum-master
Description: The sprint velocity chart is showing inflated numbers. Investigation reveals that when a story is moved between sprints (scope change), its story points are counted in both the origin and destination sprint. Expected behavior: points should only count in the sprint where the story was completed. Additionally, sub-task story points are being double-counted when the parent story also has points assigned. This affects sprint planning accuracy and stakeholder reporting.

Summary: Implement automated canary deployment pipeline
Creator: infra-lead
Description: Replace our blue-green deployment with progressive canary deployment to reduce blast radius of bad releases. Requirements: 1) Automatic 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% traffic progression 2) Promotion criteria: error rate < 0.1%, P99 latency < baseline + 10%, no OOM kills 3) Automatic rollback on criteria violation 4) Minimum observation period: 5 minutes per stage 5) Integrated with Prometheus metrics for automated analysis 6) Slack notifications at each promotion/rollback 7) Manual approval gate option for critical services 8) Support for both HTTP and gRPC traffic splitting via Istio
Comment: 20/Jan/26 3:00 PM;tchen;Canary controller deployed using Flagger + Istio. Tested with a deliberately broken deployment - automatic rollback triggered within 2 minutes of promotion to 5%. Working on the Slack integration and manual approval gate.;;;
